name: Banh canh
summary: Thick noodles of rice flour or bột lọc under roasted pork, fish cake, seafood, and herbs, with green chili and garlic-chili fish sauce on the side.
origin: Hoi An, where it is a familiar local bowl.
howToEat: Top the thick noodles with roasted pork, fish cake, herbs, and seafood, then add green chili, chili sauce, and garlic-chili fish sauce to taste.
seoTitle: Banh canh — thick noodles in Hoi An
seoDescription: Bánh canh in Hoi An is rice-flour or bột lọc noodles, with roasted pork, fish cake, herbs, or seafood.
